tips.title: Quick Safety Tips
tips.tip1: Never share your Nafath or Absher OTP codes with anyone, even if they claim to be from a government agency.
tips.tip2: Check the sender's email address carefully. Official emails from Saudi banks never ask for your password.
tips.tip3: If you receive a call claiming to be from a ministry, hang up and call the official number directly.
tips.tip4: Legitimate organizations like SAMA and banks will never ask for your full card number via SMS.
tips.tip5: Be cautious of messages claiming you won a prize from STC, Mobily, or Zain. Verify through official apps.
tips.tip6: Enable two-factor authentication on all your accounts, especially Absher and banking apps.

services.failTitle: Why most awareness programs don't work
services.failSubtitle: PhishAware was built to fix the three reasons traditional training falls flat.
services.fail1Desc: Static slides employees skim through in 5 minutes and forget by lunch. No retention, no behavior change.
services.fail2Desc: Generic Western examples that don't reflect what scammers actually use against Saudi employees — Absher, Nafath, Saudi Post, SAMA.
services.fail3Desc: If you can't see who clicks, who reports, and who improves, you can't prove the program works — or fix it when it doesn't.
services.diffSubtitle: A complete awareness lifecycle, not a slide deck.
services.diff1Desc: Send realistic phishing emails to your employees. See who clicks, who reports, who ignores — captured in real time.
services.diff2Desc: Pre-built templates referencing Absher, Nafath, SAMA, SADAD, and Saudi Post — the brands scammers actually impersonate.
services.diff3Desc: Two custom-trained LSTM models (English + Arabic) generate fresh phishing scenarios, so employees can't memorize specific emails.
services.diff4Desc: Every employee has a live risk score recalculated after every event — simulation behavior, quiz performance, training completion.
services.diff5Desc: Every page, every email, every quiz — fully in English and Arabic with proper RTL layout. Not a bolt-on translation.
services.diff6Desc: Badges, points, and a leaderboard turn security training from a chore into something employees actually finish.
